summary.judgment: The former demo-specific hydration mismatch is fixed. All 310 server-rendered and hydrated SVG coordinate records match exactly, the component produces no hydration, console, or page errors, and its full guided task remains correct in light and dark themes. global_root_layout_observation.finding: A direct load with a persisted dark-theme preference can produce a RootLayout hydration mismatch because the pre-hydration script adds data-theme=dark to the html element while the server-rendered element lacks that attribute.
global_root_layout_observation.separation_evidence: Default lesson hydration is clean; changing to dark with the native in-page theme toggle is clean; all 310 component SVG coordinates remain identical in both audited themes.
global_root_layout_observation.follow_up: Track and repair persisted-theme RootLayout hydration separately, then verify direct persisted-light and persisted-dark loads without suppressing diagnostics.
